brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the safety and effectiveness of KRP-104 on glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on metformin alone.
brief_title: Safety and Efficacy of Once-Daily KRP-104 in Type 2 Diabetics With Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin Alone
official_title: A 24-Week, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Asses the Safety and Efficacy of Once-Daily KRP-104 in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes With Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin Alone.

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in HbA1c From Baseline (Week 0) to Week 24
